notes: DCA obligation: present need 10, prospective need 109 — accepted by Township. VLA yields RDP 10 (from 3 sites). Unmet need 99. Plan addresses 10 RDP via 2 inclusionary sites (29 Fairfield Dr and 210/222 Rochelle Ave) and 23 units of unmet need via 375 West Passaic St (Ramada Inn, available ~2028). Docket BER-L-000583-25 filed 06/26/2025. Present need met via Bergen County Rehabilitation Program + municipal rehab program. Block/lot identifications come from map captions in Section 4 of the HEFSP. Revised December 2025 version also on file but the June 2025 adopted plan was verified.

sources.title: Rochelle Park Township Housing Element and Fair Share Plan Part 1 (Adopted June 25, 2025)
sources.excerpt: 4th Round Obligation (2025-2035): 109 units ... Present Need (Rehabilitation) Obligation: 10 ... RDP of 10 RDP units ... sites: 29 Fairfield Dr/70 West Passaic St, 210 & 222 Rochelle Ave, 375 West Passaic Street

sites.quote: Map 4: Site 1: 29 Fairfield Dr/ 70 W. Passaic St ... Block 90, Lots 2.02 & 3 / Block 91.01.1, Lots 1-5 & 9 ... 1.3 acres ... 15 units per acre ... 19 units ... 20 percent set-aside ... 4 affordable housing units
sites.notes: Located on northwest corner of W. Passaic Street and Fairfield Drive. 1.3 acres, 15 du/ac = 19 total units, 20% = 4 affordable. Addresses 4 of the 10 RDP units. Township rejected a 300-unit proposal at this site.

sites.quote: Map 567: Site 210 & 222 Rochelle Ave ... Block 23, Lot 2.03 / Block 24.01, Lots 1, 2 & 3 ... 1.45 acres ... 20 units per acre ... 29 apartments ... 20 percent for affordable units ... 6 deed-restricted
sites.notes: Currently developed with a bank and a diner. AINR designated 2019 (non-condemnation). Mixed-use: at-grade retail, apartments above. 1.45 acres, 20 du/ac = 29 units, 20% = 6 affordable. Addresses 6 of the 10 RDP units.

sites.quote: Map 6: Site 375 West Passaic St. ... Block 103.01, Lot 1.01, 2 ... 3.89 acres ... Ramada Inn ... 30 units per acre within a maximum 4 story building ... 116 units ... 23 of the units being set-aside for affordable housing (a 20 percent set-aside)
sites.notes: Currently occupied by Ramada Inn. Preliminary discussions ongoing; site anticipated available ~2028. 3.89 acres, 30 du/ac, 4 stories max = 116 total units, 20% = 23 affordable. Addresses 23 units of unmet need.
